Joshing QA walkthrough — 2026-09-26

Exhaustive phone-width walkthrough of production (joshing-11.vercel.app), accounts A / B / C

Run 10:34–13:09 ET, Saturday 26 Sep 2026 · Viewport 390 px wide (≈390×759; see "How this was run") plus one desktop pass at 1280 px · Accounts: A = Duo Prova (+1 555-222-2222, kept), B = Tre Prova (+1 555-333-3333, created and deleted this run), C = Quat Prova (+1 555-444-4444, created and deleted this run) · All times Eastern (EDT).

1 · Summary

Critical
“Never show this question” has never worked in production. Every press returns 500 from POST /api/questions/hide, the round view goes blank with “Could not hide that question.”, and the HiddenQuestion table holds zero rows ever. Reproduced 2/2 (C1).

Most of the core loop works well at phone size: sign-up by invite, onboarding, a first round in about 30 seconds, generous grading (a typo, a vague “King Charles of France”, and a near-synonym were all marked right), and the friend system’s privacy rules (quiet decline, blocks hiding both people from each other, blocked invites refused without revealing the block, unblock not restoring the friendship). Several issues from yesterday’s report are fixed.

The main problems, besides C1:

  • “Skip for now” on a bonus question says it “rested” the whole topic (“Resting Mozart. You won’t see these in your five.”), but it didn’t. The code shows that message for every skipped bonus (S1, 2/2).
  • The recap shows the answers to questions you chose to “skip for now”, so they are spoiled before they “come back another day” (S2; also in yesterday’s report).
  • The welcome tour makes up activity for a real person: “Duo Prova sent you a question they wrote”, “aced all five in Tennis Fundamentals” (S3).
  • Feed rows that are no longer true come back: after block → unblock, B’s home says “Duo Prova accepted your friend request” and “is now a friend”, but they aren’t friends (S4).
  • Catch-up says “You’re all caught up” and then offers the same question again straight away (S5, 2/2).
  • “People you invited” never lists people who joined by link. A’s link says “2 friends joined” while the section says “No notes sent yet.” (S6).

Accounts at the end: only A (Duo Prova, +1 555-222-2222) still exists. B (Tre Prova) was deleted at 13:05 and C (Quat Prova) at 13:06, both through the app’s Delete account flow, and both numbers now return “Joshing is invite-only”.

How this was run

  • Viewport. resize_window has no effect on this machine and the Chrome tab reports visibilityState=hidden. So the app was loaded in a same-origin <iframe> 390 px wide, filling the tab height (759 px, a little shorter than a 390×844 phone). The desktop pass used a 1280 px iframe scaled to fit. Screenshots are cropped to the phone frame.
  • Two accounts at once. Chrome windows share cookies, so separate windows can’t hold two sessions. I switched accounts by logging out and logging in again (OTP 000000) through the app’s own /api/auth/request-otp and /verify-otp. I used the full login UI for A (10:39), B (10:42) and C (10:51).
  • Side effects of the harness. Because the tab is hidden, rendering is throttled. Some screenshots timed out and were retried. Mouse-wheel scrolling doesn’t reach the iframe, so I scrolled with script where needed. Typing sometimes didn’t land on the first try. None of these are filed as app bugs.
  • Database. I ran read-only queries (inside BEGIN READ ONLY) only to confirm what happened (skip rows, the HiddenQuestion count, queue dates). I made no database writes.
  • Console. Errors were captured in the iframe (hooked console.error, onerror, unhandledrejection) and with the tab-level reader. Browser dialogs were stubbed to log instead of block. No native dialogs appeared.

3 · Areas

3.1 Onboarding & auth

What worked. Uninvited numbers get Joshing is invite-only. Ask a friend who's already on Joshing to send you an invite. Opening an invite link shows Duo invited you to Joshing, a trivia game built for you. Verify your phone number and you and Duo will be friends. A wrong code gives Code invalid or expired. Change number keeps the invite banner. Profile setup explains itself: an empty submit shows Enter your display name., a taken handle shows That username is already taken., and the button is disabled with the reason on screen. Topic setup’s disabled button says Pick at least 3 to start, then 4 selected · add up to 8 more. The first five were ready about 30 s after onboarding, with friendly loader copy (Finding the right multitudes, Tuning the difficulty).

Problems.

  • The code screen has no “Resend code” link, only Change number. Re-entering the same number is the only way to get a new code (S10).
  • At 390×759, the invite-only message sits at 722–800 px, partly below the fold. It has no role="alert" or aria-live, so screen readers won’t announce it (S10).
  • The number is shown as (555)-222-2222 (extra hyphen). After Change number, the field refills as raw +15554444444 (N8).
  • The username auto-fills from the display name. Clicking into it while the card was still animating mangled it into treptreprovarova. Bad characters are dropped silently (9Quat! → quat). Same as yesterday (N16).
  • There is no avatar step, so every new player is an initial on a tile (N16).
  • The display-name placeholder is Jane Palay / jpalay, the app owner’s surname and real handle (N18).
  • A returning login as A went straight to the SMS ask (Get a text when your five open) again. This is a repeat of yesterday’s report.
  • Joining by link makes the friendship with no confirmation screen. The only sign is the bonus label “From Duo’s world” and a feed row. This is a repeat.

Not tested: an expired code. The OTP bypass code never expires, so this can’t be tested with test numbers (see Untested).

3.8 Console

The tab-level reader recorded 8 uncaught Error: Connection closed. exceptions (chunk 28ca1cf1fd289851.js) at 10:35:05, 10:46:48, 10:47:38, 10:50:50, 10:56:05, 10:59:37, 11:21:46 and 11:30:32 (N15). The iframe hook recorded no console.error calls. Failing network calls: POST /api/questions/hide 500 (10:54, 10:55); the expected refusals (/api/invite-links/accept 400, /api/friend-invitations/accept-… 400, /api/friend-invitations 409, /api/friends/search 429).

Possible cause — The times line up with moments I navigated or switched accounts while a page was still loading, which looks like a React Server Components stream being cut off. They may be harmless, but they are unhandled.

4 · Prioritized issues

Critical

C1 · Critical · reproduced 2/2
“Never show this question” always fails with a server error and blanks the round.

Repro 10:54 and 10:55 ET · C · /daily · Q2 (1494 Medici) → NOT FOR ME → Never show this question. Every question area disappears; only Could not hide that question. [Try again] is left. Try again just reloads the round, and the question comes back. POST /api/questions/hide → 500 both times. Read-only DB check: table HiddenQuestion exists (6 columns) and has 0 rows ever. So the feature has never worked in production, and “Settings › Hidden questions” can never list anything.

The catch-up page (src/app/daily/catchup/page.tsx:67) calls the same endpoint without checking the response, so there it fails silently while the card is dismissed.

Screenshots SS-65, SS-66, SS-67

Possible cause — The route (src/app/api/questions/hide/route.ts) has no try/catch, so any insert error becomes a 500. The id column has no database default, which rules out a missing-table problem. A likely candidate is a foreign-key mismatch: the client sends question_id when a slot has no generated_question_id, and some slot ids may not exist in Question (e.g. editorial or bank ids). The Vercel runtime logs for 14:54–14:55 UTC will show the real error.

5 · Questions for Josh

  • Q1 · Unfriending erases shared history. At 11:03 A unfriended B. B’s home immediately dropped the bonus dots, and B’s recap lost both bonus cards (they had been “from Duo’s knowledge”). For a block, scrubbing makes sense. For a plain unfriend it quietly rewrites what B played today. Should an unfriend keep past rounds as they were?
  • Q2 · Mutual-friend suggestions need both people opted in, and the default is OFF. So “People you may know” never appears unless two people have both found and flipped a setting. If this feature matters for growth, consider ON by default for the person being suggested (like stranger discovery), or needing only the suggested person’s consent.
  • Q3 · “Four in a row at one point.” This is a within-round note, not a daily streak, but it is the same kind of counting-runs language the no-streaks principle avoids. Worth a softer line?
  • Q4 · Catch-up replays a question you just missed again. The deliberate-decision list says today’s misses can be replayed right away. It doesn’t cover a question missed twice within a minute coming straight back (S5). Is a cool-down intended?
  • Q5 · The blocked person can still see the blocker’s invite card. Opening A’s invite link as blocked B still shows Duo Prova invited you… [Accept Duo Prova’s invitation], and only the Accept press fails. B already holds the link, so little leaks, but a generic “invitation unavailable” before pressing would match how the rest of blocking behaves.

6 · Untested (and what would unblock it)

  • Expired OTP code. The bypass code 000000 never expires. Needs a real, non-bypass test number, or a way to backdate an OtpCode row in a non-production database.
  • Expired invite link. Personal invites rest after Oct 26. Needs a DB-backdated invitation (a production write, so not done) or a preview environment.
  • B’s new round while blocked (“from …’s world” bonuses). B’s round was played before the block, and the next round opens at 1 PM, after the unblock and re-friending. Checked instead: after the block, B’s existing recap and home had no Duo attribution. Needs a block that stays in place across a 1 PM rollover.
  • Real 390×844 viewport and touch. resize_window has no effect here; I used a 390×759 iframe with mouse input. Needs a real phone or a working resize.
  • SMS and email sending. I didn’t opt in (“Not right now” / “I’ll check back on my own”) to avoid sending to test numbers.

7 · Principle audit

PrincipleVerdictEvidence
No streaks, leaderboards, or coercive mechanicsmostlyNo streak counter, leaderboard or guilt copy seen. The word “streak” from yesterday’s home screen is gone. Copy is gentle: Some you didn’t land will find their way back to you., See you next Sunday. Caveats: Four in a row at one point. (Q3); the SMS ask again at every login (repeat); the ceremony’s count-up number.
Wrong answers feel like connection momentspassYou’ll know this one next time., NOW IT’S IN YOURS TOO, Right era, wrong crooner—Armstrong was legendary, but Sinatra owned this one., ARGUE YOUR POINT, Half right—he’s got the arm…. One slip: That’s the round — 0 of 1. right after a catch-up miss reads like a score.
Color never carries meaning alonemixedGood: answers use ✓/✕ plus words; frequency uses bar icons; toggles move the knob; dots have screen-reader labels. Accepted: right/wrong dots are color-only. Gaps: the Mastery legend swatches are identical (N7), so its colors mean nothing; skipped bonus dots are grey vs unanswered hollow, a subtle difference.
Grading fails toward the playerpass (with accepted exception)Typo Ufizzi ✓, vague King Charles of France ✓, synonym rebadging ✓, Queen of Night ✓, Uffizi Gallery ✓, and in A’s old round Lorenzo de Medici for Lorenzo di Pierfrancesco ✓. Partly-right multi-part a withered arm ✗ is the accepted exception.

8 · Suggestions for improvement

  • Make “Skip for now” honest end to end. Give it its own message (“Skipped — it’ll come back”), keep the answer hidden in the recap until it has come back and been answered, and use the “Resting X” line only for the bag/rest option.
  • Build the tour mock from the real account, or use obviously fictional names. A friend’s real name next to invented activity is the one place the app says something untrue about a person.
  • Treat feed rows as current state, not a log, for relationship events: drop or rewrite “is now a friend” / “accepted your request” when the friendship ends.
  • Fold link-joiners into “People you invited” (“Tre joined via ‘Renaissance Florence & Great Lakes shipwrecks’ · now friends”). It would give the inviter the confirmation that joining by link currently lacks.
  • Add a light confirmation after friendship-making actions (accept request, accept invite, join via link): a toast like “You and Tre are now friends”.
  • Resend code on the OTP screen with a cooldown, and role="alert" on login errors, scrolled into view.
  • Check “already friends / blocked” when the phone number is entered in invite-by-phone, not after the ideas step.
  • Taxonomy guardrails: map geography-type topics (Australian Geography, US State Capitals) to Geography, merge “Musical Theater” into “Theater & Musicals”, and don’t make a single book its own top-level category.
  • Mastery legend: draw the swatches the way the map draws the levels (size or fill), or drop the legend and keep the section headings.
  • Catch-up: after a second miss, say something like “We’ll bring this one back another day” and hold it back for a while.
